repairs: Index the secondary run/level table with code >> 6, without an extra pointer indirection.
Extract an unsigned packed run-code byte from bits 2..9, then shift the promoted byte right by two.
Retain the block index before the stuffing/escape retry loop; retries bypass the outer start-delimiter check.
Use the input SJCK signed length and compute consumed bytes as current byte position minus chunk start.
Keep the low three residual bits with & 7. The continuation variant reads exactly one post-block continuation bit.
Remove unjustified volatile accesses and identity read/call wrappers; use SJ/SJCK from the existing shared header.
